sections.title: Quick Inferences
sections.passage:
"The children like to play indoors during the cold winter months."

"It was time to turn the lights on."

"Greg didn't have time to finish his breakfast before he had to catch the bus."

Read each sentence and answer the question.

responses.prompt: When would the children most likely play outdoors?
What time of the day was it likely to be?
What time of the day was it?

sections.title: The Noise
sections.passage: Tears ran down the baby's red face. The noise filled the house. A full bottle lay dripping onto the floor.

responses.response: because the bottle was on the ground instead in the baby's arms

sections.title: Waiting
sections.passage: I had been waiting for ten minutes. I suddenly realised I had forgotten to put my homework in my bag. By the time I got back the bus was gone.

responses.prompt: Why did he miss the bus?
responses.response: because he was getting to get his homework

sections.title: On The Bus
sections.passage: "You can't bring that on here, boy!" said the bus driver looking at the squirming piglet in Wade's arms...

responses.prompt: Why was Wade about to burst into tears?
responses.response: because the bus driver didn't allow piglets to be in the bus

responses.prompt: Was Wade proud of his piglet? How do you know that?
responses.response: he was proud because he was on his way to his grandad's place so he can show of the piglet

responses.prompt: Why did Wade go to the back of the bus?
responses.response: so the bus driver wont notice the piglet

responses.prompt: Why did he hold the school bag so carefully?
responses.response: so the bus driver wont notice the piglet in his bag

questionScores.rationale: Correct — 'summer' is an accepted seasonal inference opposite to winter.
Correct — 'night' correctly infers it was getting dark.
Correct — 'morning' correctly identifies breakfast-time school bus context.
Correct — 'crying' is the accepted inference for the noise.
Correct — student identifies bottle on the ground away from the baby as the cause.
Correct — 'bus stop' is the expected inference.
Correct — student identifies returning to get homework, though phrasing is a little awkward ('getting to get').
Correct — identifies the bus driver's refusal to allow the piglet on board.
Correct — 'the grandfather' owned the mother pig.
Correct — states he was proud and gives evidence of going to show grandfather.
Correct — identifies hiding the piglet from the bus driver.

Incorrect — says 'bus driver wont notice the piglet in his bag'; the question is about why he held the bag carefully (to not wake/disturb the piglet), not about the driver. The hiding-from-driver reason is more relevant to q6d.
